# Rainham Windows project requirements

Read these instructions before working on this repository.

## Facts and confirmation

- The supplied legal identity is Rainham Windows Limited, company number 12019799.
- Official domain: https://www.rainhamwindows.co.uk/.
- The supplied Rainham, Essex / Havering / RM13 base is an assumption, not a verified address.
- The original website advertises windows, doors, conservatories, porches, bi-fold doors, uPVC projects and London coverage.
- Full service list, address, towns served, phone, email, opening hours, accreditations, guarantees, lead times, finance, prices and third-party profiles require confirmation.
- Never fabricate business facts, testimonials, ratings, prices, project towns or qualifications. Use `{{CONFIRM: what is needed}}` for unknown information.
- Do not advertise additional products from the keyword map as available without confirmation.
- This is a public test website. Keep noindex and crawler blocking until an approved production launch. They are not access controls.

## Content and search

- British English, UK spelling and pounds sterling.
- All primary content and FAQs must be in generated HTML, not loaded by JavaScript.
- One H1 per page, logical heading order, answer-first sections.
- At least 400 useful words per service page and 300 per location page. No town-name-swapped duplicate copy.
- Each page identifies the business, purpose, audience and geographic context within the first 100 words. Distinguish proposed coverage from confirmed coverage.
- Identical name, address and phone wherever they occur. Omit unknown schema properties rather than inserting empty values or confirmation markers.
- Titles at most 60 characters; meta descriptions at most 155 characters.
- Lowercase, hyphenated, extensionless URLs, canonical/Open Graph/Twitter metadata on every page.
- Preserve /gallery, /contact and /legal-notice. Use real 301 redirects if an existing URL must change.
- Add factual business schema, Service schema on confirmed services, matching FAQPage and inner-page BreadcrumbList. No invented reviews, coordinates, hours or sameAs links.
- Header: Windows, Doors, Conservatories, Repairs, Areas, Guides, Gallery, Reviews, Contact.
- Services link to related services, a guide and at least three area pages; areas link to services and two neighbouring areas; guides link to matching services.
- Clear quote form and phone CTA at the end of each page. A form without a backend must explicitly say it does not send anything.
- Captions identify product, colour and finish; use confirmation markers for unverified project towns.
- Use WebP/AVIF, image dimensions, lazy loading below the fold, accessible labels, keyboard navigation and WCAG AA contrast. Target mobile Lighthouse 90+, but measure before claiming it.
- Cost/comparison guides must not invent figures. Display a real revision date.
- Production crawler policy and sitemap may allow search/AI bots once approved. llms.txt is optional and has unproven discovery benefit.

## Supplied keyword map

The user supplied Semrush estimates dated 14 November 2026. They are not independently verified.

Proposed local pages: Essex, Romford, Dagenham, Hornchurch, Upminster, Havering and Rainham, Essex. Confirm the geographic base and coverage first; use the Kent/Medway alternative only if the business confirms that region.

Confirmed catalogue themes: double glazing, replacement windows, uPVC windows, anthracite grey windows, doors, bi-fold doors, conservatories and porches.

Awaiting service confirmation: composite doors, uPVC doors, French doors, sliding patio doors, aluminium windows, sash windows, secondary/triple glazing, orangeries, conservatory roof replacement, roof lanterns, misted-glass repairs, emergency glazing and finance.

Useful guide/FAQ themes: double-glazing cost, lifespan, how double glazing works, composite versus uPVC doors, replacement-window quotations, internal condensation, and maintenance. Never present a keyword estimate as evidence of a business offering.
